raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 5, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the evidence by conflating the 1943 date of the historical Cairo Declaration with the film’s release, despite sources indicating the film was released in 2015; thus incorrectly concluded Cairo Declaration came out before Natürlich die Nelli (1959).
